title: Joe's modern jazz approach and the pleasure of good company
summary: Joe says he plays modern jazz, mostly chords, and a good band brings more out of a player.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels

blocks.x: And, to get back to myself, I have always been a great lover of music. And, I heard you ask sometime in the early part of the day, about the style of music I played and so forth. Well, today, I'll put it this way. I say I try to play the modern type of jazz. And, mostly in the chords. And, solo, likewise. And, I enjoy my work. And, what makes me enjoy my work, mostly when I have fellas like Hal and Harry, is something about a good musician can bring more out of a fella than he actually has in himself.
